purpose: Production lock evidence manifest for canonical PostgreSQL/EAI runtime
rule: A gate is PASS only when its evidence is tied to the same exact commit SHA as this manifest. Missing, stale, or unbound evidence is NOT_VERIFIED.

required: Run concurrent migration attempts against the same real PostgreSQL database
Prove schema_version has exactly one row per version and a database-enforced unique key
Prove both runners terminate without duplicate publications or migration corruption
Record the failing historical reproduction and successful fixed rerun
Boot production_entrypoint.py against PostgreSQL 16
Confirm ProductionRuntimeFactory instance construction succeeds
Confirm canonical ledger authority guard passes
Confirm PostgreSQL connectivity and fail-closed invalid configuration tests
Apply the complete versioned migration chain; create_all is not migration evidence
Assert migration history is contiguous and checksums match
Assert Escrow, Ledger accounts/movements, Witness, Outbox, and Idempotency tables, columns, constraints, and unique keys
Verify schema guard against a fresh database and a supported legacy upgrade
Bind exact commit SHA to workflow run ID and workflow conclusion
Bind artifact name and SHA-256 digest
Retain test summaries and PostgreSQL version/configuration metadata
Reject evidence from a different commit SHA
IAM role and identity inventory
MFA enforcement evidence for privileged identities
Dated privileged-access review with reviewer and outcome
Production deployment permission evidence and least-privilege review
